test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Sunny's parents said to her, "Do not take anything from strangers."

options.text: Sunny's parents advised her not to take anything from strangers.
Sunny's parents asked her do not take anything from strangers.
Sunny's parents said to her that do not take anything from strangers.
Sunny's parents told to her not to take anything from strangers.

solution:
The correct indirect speech for the given sentence is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence type is** 'Imperative sentence'.**
 
• In indirect speech, the imperative sentences (commands, requests, advice) are often reported by using verbs such as advise, ask, command, order, request, suggest, etc., followed by an **object + infinitive form of the verb.**
 
• Here, Sunny's parents are giving advice, so** "advised"** is the **correct verb** to use.
 
• The **"do not take"** in the direct speech** is converted** into **"not to take"** in indirect speech.

**Therefore,** the **correct sentence** is- Sunny's parents advised her not to take anything from strangers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are **incorrect due to the following reasons:**
 
• "Sunny 's parents asked her do not take anything from strangers." 
 
 
• This is** incorrect because** the verb "ask" in indirect speech should be followed by an object and an infinitive.
 
• So it should be "asked her not to take" instead of "asked her do not take".
 
 
 
• "Sunny 's parents said to her that do not take anything from strangers." -
 
 
• This is** incorrect because** after "said" the proper structure is "said to someone + to + infinitive" or "said that + clause".
 
• The correct form should be "said to her not to take anything from strangers".
 
 
 
• "Sunny 's parents told to her not to take anything from strangers." -
 
 
• This is **incorrect because** the verb "told" is not used with a preposition when referring to the person we're speaking to.
 
• The correct usage should be "told her not to take anything from strangers".
